# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 2.0.x   | Yes       |
| < 2.0   | No        |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security issues through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/MeherBenSalem/Fssentials/security/advisories/new) for this repository.

Do not open public issues or disclose exploit details before maintainers have had a chance to investigate and address the report.

We will acknowledge valid reports as quickly as we can and coordinate fixes and disclosure with reporters.
